name: agents-deck
description: See and switch between the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi) running in your VS Code window, resume recent sessions, and check your subscriptions' usage limits.

agentsDeck.harnesses.claude.description: Show Claude Code sessions and account.

agentsDeck.harnesses.codex.description: Show Codex CLI sessions and account.

agentsDeck.sources.terminal.description: Show agents running in this window's terminals.

agentsDeck.sources.extension.description: Show agents running in an editor extension's chat panel in this window, such as the Claude Code extension.

agentsDeck.sources.background.description: Show background sessions (Claude Code's /fork and --bg) working in this window's folders.

agentsDeck.closedSessions.maxAgeDays.description: How many days of finished sessions Closed Agents lists. 0 hides the section.

agentsDeck.accounts.enabled.description: Show the Accounts section with your subscriptions and their usage limits.

agentsDeck.refreshSeconds.description: How often the panel re-reads agent status, in seconds.
